src/qkd_hake/benchmarks/plot_performance_figures.py

src/qkd_hake/qkd_mock/pool.py

Finite available-key inventory with lazy refill. Issuance consumes inventory; peer retrieval removes a pending key without replenishing inventory. Uses software randomness, not quantum hardware. Duplicate IDs within one retrieval request remain an accounting edge case.
